Before merging, please make sure you _and someone else_ have completed the following tasks. If they're obviously not applicable to your changes, you can delete it.

**Lockup Tests**

- [ ] Created a new Lockup
- [ ] Extended an existing Lockup

**Bid Tests**

- [ ] Voted in two tranches
- [ ] Changed votes in both
- [ ] Viewed a token-based bid detail page
- [ ] Viewed a point-based bid detail page
- [ ] Sanity checked the Average APR
  - Does it seem realistic as the weighted average of the APRs in the tranche?
- [ ] Manually checked 1-2 APR numbers ([Guide](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1itKN_eYM5yYGJmd-cg05IHTrkSHVPZfhTIBh5-yUiEs/edit?tab=t.0))

**Metrics Page Tests**

- [ ] Confirmed data is visible for prior rounds and matches production

**Reward Claiming Tests**

- [ ] Claimed in ATOM
- [ ] Claimed in Native Token
